title: Qualify Acarat for production and evidence-driven scale-out
outcome: Acarat reaches a production release with security, privacy, resilience, Arabic/RTL, accessibility, performance, source/NOTICE/SBOM, incident, and Saudi regulatory evidence, then admits scale infrastructure only through measured triggers.
rationale: Program-level release/scale child spanning roadmap P20-P21. It must be refined into exact release and scale-gate Grains.
scope_in: P20 production hardening and launch qualification
scope_out: Premature Kubernetes/Kafka/vector/graph/warehouse adoption without measured need
acceptance: Release and scale work is decomposed into bounded Grains with exact-source preservation, CI/security evidence, backup/restore, performance, privacy, accessibility, Arabic/RTL, source compliance, runbooks, and measurable scale triggers.

risk.recovery: Planning child only; production release requires separate qualified release Grain.
